userGuide.rationale: The release fixes macOS installation handoff and has an unavoidable migration boundary: 0.22.0 and 0.22.1 cannot execute their detached update helper. The Updates section now tells those users to replace PLVS from the DMG once and states that 0.22.2 and later restore in-app installation.
evidence: docs/user/system-settings.md Updates section compared with CHANGELOG.md [0.22.2]
src-tauri/src/update_worker.rs macOS helper path copies plvs-update-worker.app with its complete bundle signature
git diff v0.22.1..10d9fce2 -- docs/user: system-settings.md is the only changed user-guide chapter

readme.rationale: This patch restores an existing automatic-update promise and adds no feature, panel, platform or workflow. The README highlights remain accurate and do not describe version-specific update recovery.
evidence: git diff v0.22.1..10d9fce2 -- README.md is empty
README.md highlights compared with CHANGELOG.md [0.22.2]: no affected product highlight or screenshot claim

website.rationale: The homepage promises and download links remain accurate; the updated user guide is rendered into the Docs page by the existing website build. Privacy review: the complete range changes only local update-helper copying, release tooling and version metadata. It adds no collection, consent, payload, recipient/provider, storage, retention, deletion, network request or third-party service, so website/privacy/index.html, docs/privacy-review.json and the effective date remain unchanged.
evidence: git diff v0.22.1..10d9fce2 -- website/index.html website/privacy/index.html is empty
git diff v0.22.1..10d9fce2 -- src-tauri/src/update_worker.rs: local bundle copy and path validation only; no network or telemetry code
docs/user/system-settings.md is an input to the generated Docs page; npm run website:verify is included in the release preflight
node scripts/privacy-review.mjs check passes through npm test; no policy text or data-handling behavior changed

screenshots.rationale: The patch changes only a headless native installation helper and version metadata. It does not change any visible application or website layout, label, theme, panel, Dock surface or screenshot state, so all tracked screenshots still match the product.
evidence: git diff v0.22.1..10d9fce2 -- src website/assets README.md contains no UI component, CSS or image change
CHANGELOG.md [0.22.2] describes only updater handoff behavior and one-time manual migration guidance
